discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B006 (packets 206, 410, 455), Disney Store US/UK/EU + Disney Studio Store Hollywood 2019. 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. Main yield: DSSH 2019 monthly releases (Jan-Apr, Jul, Oct-Dec), May 2019 Pin Trader Delight flips, Toys for Tots 2019, DSSH Little Mermaid 30th surprise series, all with per-pin edition sizes from dated DPB posts. Also Kiss the Girl set (DPB + DS UK), Little Mermaid 30th DS members (held, single list), shopDisney Captain Marvel LR, TROS shopDisney LE 3200 series, TROS Times Square and Opening Night pins, Avengers Endgame LE 2200 set (members held). No existing hold released. Lion King Jumbo Park Pack lead resolved as 2018 (packet 463). Resellers (yourwdwstore, magicalearscollectibles, fryguypins, madhousecollectibles, toywiz) not used.
